scripts.features:
📋 1. Core Automation Suite
Auto Check-In / Reception:
Scans the workspace for reception desks, call bells, clipboards, shutters, and intake prompts.
Automatically rotates your camera and character toward the counter and performs authentic 1.5s - 2.0s key-holds on the E key to check in arriving patients.
Auto-Heal / Treat Patients:
Scans patient models on beds and examination tables.
Automatically detects their specific ailment (e.g., Headache, Fever, Bleeding, Broken Bone, Infection).
Equips the exact matching medical tool from your inventory (Herbs, Thermometer, Bandage, Splint, Antibiotics, etc.) and administers treatment.
Auto-Use Machines:
Identifies diagnostic equipment, lab scanners, x-rays, analyzers, and computers.
Automatically interacts with and runs diagnostic tests when required.
Auto-Interact (ALL Prompts):
Global dynamic scanner that activates every proximity prompt and click detector in range without needing static model paths.
☕ 2. Sanity Protection & Coffee Loop
Server-Verified Sanity Protection:
Tracks real server-authoritative sanity levels to prevent client-side desync or rubberbanding.
200s Timed Coffee TP Brew Loop:
Synchronized with the game's ~200-second coffee brewing timer.
When sanity dips below 75% or when coffee finishes brewing (~195s–200s), it saves your exact coordinates, teleports to the Coffee Machine, aims camera, grabs fresh coffee, equips and drinks it, and immediately teleports back to your previous location.
🛡️ 3. Combat & Threat Defense
Auto-Taser & Weapon Defense:
Scans for hostility anomalies and monster models (Skinwalkers, Stalkers, Hiders, Head Bangers, Tendrils).
Automatically equips your Taser or Gun and attacks hostiles upon detection.
Auto Feed Bed Monster:
Automatically equips Maple Syrup and treats bed monster anomalies under cots before they attack.
👁️ 4. Visuals & ESP
Patient / Animal ESP: Highlights all sick patients and animals in Green through walls with their name and active ailment.
Anomaly / Monster ESP: Highlights all hostile entities and threats in Red (!! Monster Name) through walls.
Universal ESP: Highlights tools, inventory items, and other players.
⚡ 5. Movement & Utilities (Universal)
Custom WalkSpeed & JumpPower (adjustable sliders).
Noclip (walk through walls/doors).
Anti-AFK (prevents idle kick).
Auto Game Detection: Instantly loads this entire suite whenever you join Animal Hospital.
